Microsoft PowerPoint

Create, find, inspect, fill, edit, format, share, preview, version, copy, upload, download, organize, and delete Microsoft PowerPoint files through Microsoft Graph and OneDrive, including slide, shape, chart, comment, and geometry workflows.

What your bot can do in Microsoft PowerPoint

Looks up

  • Download PresentationDownload a PowerPoint file in its original format or export it as PDF or JPG.
  • Download Presentation VersionVerify that the selected DriveItem is a PPTX, then download one retained previous version as a bounded PPTX file.
  • Find PresentationsList a folder or search a drive and return only PowerPoint files.
  • Get Current DriveReturn the signed-in user's default OneDrive ID and basic owner, type, and quota details.
  • Get PresentationReturn metadata for one PowerPoint file by item ID, including its current eTag for concurrency-safe updates.
  • Get Presentation ContentRead bounded, text-first semantic content from a current macro-free PPTX, including slides, shapes, text, safe hyperlinks, alt text, image…
  • Get Presentation LayoutsDownload and validate the current macro-free PPTX, then return its complete bounded slide-layout catalog.
  • Get Presentation ThumbnailsList generated thumbnail metadata for a PowerPoint presentation.
  • Get Presentation VersionRetrieve compact metadata for one retained or current version of a PowerPoint file.
  • List Presentation VersionsList retained versions of a PowerPoint file in Microsoft Graph's newest-first order, one provider page at a time.

  • Invite People to PresentationGrant named people read or write access to a PowerPoint presentation.
  • Replace Presentation FileReplace the bytes of an existing PowerPoint DriveItem with a valid, non-macro-enabled PPTX package no larger than 250 MiB, optionally…
